Thanks Linda — sending this over to AP and procurement for the PO. A few asks to make sure we don't hit a conditional hold:

1) Completed & signed W-9 (or W-8BEN-E if the ultimate payee is non-US). The unsigned form you attached is fine as the template, but we need the signed PDF with the EIN filled in.

2) TIN crosswalk: because you noted multiple EINs across the group, please provide a simple crosswalk that maps (a) invoice remit entity name, (b) legal entity name, and (c) EIN used for tax/reporting. A spreadsheet is best.

3) Signatory authority: if the person signing the W-9 is not listed on the articles/incorporation doc, please attach a short letter or a board resolution showing signing authority.

I've attached a small TIN_Crosswalk_Template.xlsx to make the mapping quick. If you can return the signed W-9 plus the completed crosswalk and any signer evidence, my team can push the PO to AP immediately.

Hi Linda / Rishi,

Looping AP to confirm a couple of items so we can finalize the PO once we have the signed tax docs and the crosswalk:

- Remit-to address (format we need: legal name | remittance address | ACH details if applicable)
- Tax classification (C corp / S corp / LLC taxed as corp / sole proprietor) — this goes on the W-9; please ensure the box is checked.
- Payee name as it should appear on the PO (this needs to match the W-9 legal name ideally).
- If invoices will be issued by a subsidiary (different EIN), please indicate which product lines map to which legal entity.

I've attached our AP_Checklist_for_Vendor_Onboarding.pdf for your convenience. Karthik, can you confirm whether Redwood will accept a subsidiary EIN on the PO as long as the crosswalk and signer evidence are provided?
